title: Programming languages
prompt: Classify each language by its primary execution style.
triples: C source is compiled directly to machine code for the target platform.
Rust uses ahead-of-time compilation to native binaries.
Go compiles to native executables, often as a single binary.
Python is typically executed by an interpreter (CPython).
JavaScript is run by engines in browsers and runtimes like Node.js.
Ruby is generally executed by an interpreter such as MRI.
